description: This file defines a reducer for managing data masks in a dashboard application, handling actions such as hydration, updates, and removal of data masks, with support for native filters and chart customizations.

methods.name: isChartCustomizationItem
methods.description: Type guard to check if an item is a ChartCustomization object.

methods.name: getInitialDataMask
methods.description: Creates an initial DataMask object with optional id and additional properties.

methods.name: fillNativeFilters
methods.description: Populates the data mask with native filter configurations, merging default and current filter states.

methods.name: updateDataMaskForFilterChanges
methods.description: Updates the data mask based on filter modifications, deletions, and whether chart customization changes are involved.
